translation: The huantiao (環跳) is the outward-facing hollow of the hip bone, whose form resembles a mortar, and it receives the upper end of the thigh bone (髀骨) like a pestle; it is called the ji (機), also called the bishu (髀樞), and is the place of the huantiao point (環跳穴). Whether from an injury by a fall or blow, or from a sprain, a fall, or catching the stirrup, causing the pivot (樞機) to be misaligned and strained, with bruising, swelling, and pain, and inability to walk, or walking and stopping with difficulty and leaning to one side, one should first take Zhenggu Zijin Dan (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹), wash with Haitongpi Tang (Erythrina Bark Decoction, 海桐皮湯), apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏), and regularly take Jianbu Huqian Wan (Agile-Steps Tiger-Crouching Pill, 健步虎潛丸).
